scientific_integrity: The bare additive SU-rank computation is not claimed as novel; Mirabi's later coordinatization theorem covers that phenomenon more generally. Originality is restricted to the exact identification with the tree-plan counting polynomial, local asymptotic exponents, coefficientwise 1-type census, and finite rank-distribution formulas.
scientific_limitations: Singleton types in the pure tree-plan generic only. The finite rank statistic is attached via the corresponding limiting parameter-free type. The normalized exponent formula assumes deg(Gamma)>0. The polynomial/rank bridge may be folklore because it is a short synthesis of Mirabi's counting and rank ingredients.
title: Tree-plan counting polynomials are SU-rank partition functions
